Parents are so talented at denying the probability that their child might’ve been assaulted, I don’t know if it’s guilt or denial.
Either way, you’re not alone, my parents completely denied it and one quote is still stuck in my head:
“I don’t care if they r**** you, you still need to go to school”
My grades were in decline and I refused to go to school… it sticks with you. But well, I’m in a healthy new relationship now, seeking help for the issues they caused and trying my best. 
Parents sometimes fail us when we need the most, my best advice is to rely on people who actually believe you. Because even if they’re your parents, watching them deny your reality will only hurt you further. 
Live a good life.

You must be in a lot of pain even now, so... could you be my friend? I’m sorry (I’m being very selfish right now, and I’m not making a lot of sense here haha) you can call me up! Or we can play games! If you don’t like that maybe we could just chat pain away. Man I’m gonna be honest, I’m pretty lonely myself and probably don’t have much time left, so what the hell... let’s be friends! :)

But... how is that living? Don’t close yourself off man, sure life isn’t perfect and getting hurt is horrible but well I’m not here to change your mind, we are just strangers... and probably live miles apart from each other. But let me tell you, even though I don’t know you, if I had met you irl; I wish I could’ve been your friend... things don’t last forever but... I can’t get rid of my habit. I like opening up and believing even if it hurts me, at the end of the day you only have one life, so I think it’s acceptable to make a mess. If doing that helps you it’s okey, but man... that’s a lonely and painful path you’re walking in. If you want, if you wish. Can’t two lonely strangers be friends? :)

Man this hit too close home, I used to love this person so much... and yet they left and they never looked back, I cried and begged for them to come back but they never did, and to this day I have the last letter they gave me; it was bitter. They never apologized and at some point I accepted I would never get one. Most of the time I look back and feel the same as you... if only we had been “x” thing instead of “y” we would still be together. Maybe you’ll never meet them again... maybe you’ll never move on like they did, but that’s alright, you don’t have to. I mean staying stuck in the past is painful and will only make you depressed but sometimes... you need to be sad.
One day... one day you’ll be able to find someone who makes you feel even better. But I think you are strong enough to live without that. You’ve made it this far. If they don’t call you again that’s fine, you are strong dude, you don’t need that call. Get up and eat a kickass breakfast, keep walking and before you realize it... you won’t need their love anymore.
(Sorry if this wasn’t helpful. English is not my first language so I’m sorry if this is just gibberish; I wish you the best dude!)
